widgets_values:
Image Picker: choose an image from ComfyUI's input folder with a touch-friendly gallery.
1. Tap `🖼 Choose image` (or the preview): a full-screen gallery opens with thumbnails and file names. Scroll, search, sort, switch folders, and set the thumbnail size with S / M / L or the slider.
2. Tap an image to select it. ◀ / ▶ step through the folder; `＋ Upload` adds a new file (also: drop an image on the node).
3. Unlike the stock dropdown, nothing here closes by itself when tapped on a phone or tablet.
Outputs: IMAGE, MASK, the path inside the input folder, width, height.
